pr_title: Fix carryall not removing influence when cargo dies
pr_body:
Fixes #20468
An oversight from #16509 and then #20403

Here we make sure we properly handle cancelling regardless of where it was called. We cancel all child activities then set `ChildHasPriority` to true and `IsInterruptible` to false so that the `Takeoff` would run regardless of PickupUnit code and condition.

review_comments: This is the exact reason I didn't move this in https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/20489, before we unreserved on cargo death in all cases and not just when the state is reserved.

Looks like it was added to fix https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/16509#issuecomment-496034776 (I can't link a deleted accounts message).

After investigation to me it seems like a redundant check, shall we just remove it?
Removed. I played around even more with it and found no reason for this check to exist
Wouldn't that mean that we unreserve the carryable even when we're carrying it?
No, because the activity is not interuptable on takeoff
Where is this set? The original takeoff activity only has priority.
I had more debugging done, although it appeared to be working correct on surface, it was cancelling slightly incorrectly. Fixed
What happens if the cargo dies when the state is Reserved?
PickupUnit activity cancels and carryall becomes unreserved
Not this PR's problem, but this is all way too convoluted. :(
